description: This file defines a PHP class JobSpecificationAttachmentDecorator that acts as a decorator for the JobSpecificationAttachment entity, providing additional functionality such as retrieving file content from a resource or string, following the decorator pattern in object-oriented programming.

classes.name: JobSpecificationAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps around the JobSpecificationAttachment entity to provide enhanced access to its data, particularly the file content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a JobSpecificationAttachment entity.

methods.name: getJobSpecification
methods.description: Protected method that returns the wrapped JobSpecificationAttachment entity.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Public method that retrieves the file content; if content is a resource, it reads and stores it as a string.
